title: Lampu Jalan Depan Rumah
mood: an unreliable light that made you reliable
subject: a flickering streetlight and the neighbour's kid you walk to the gate every night
caption: Malay synthwave. A pulsing analog synth arpeggio running underneath everything, drums with a big gated-reverb snare and a steady kick, a warm wide pad, a sixteenth-note synth bass, a bright lead synth answering the vocal in the chorus. Neon-retro and wide with the gated snare and lush pads, polished in an eighties way. Soft male voice, nostalgic and plain, unforced. 100 BPM, F sharp minor. An unreliable light that made you reliable. No acoustic instruments, no trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - analog arpeggio and gated drums]

[Verse 1]
Lampu jalan depan rumah dah rosak tiga bulan
Berkelip, padam, berkelip, padam, macam tak tahu nak hidup atau mati
Aku dah report dua kali, dapat nombor rujukan
Nombor tu aku simpan, lampu tu masih berkelip

[Chorus]
Lampu jalan depan rumah
Aku dah biasa tidur dengan dia berkelip
Kalau satu malam dia terus menyala
Aku rasa aku pula yang tak boleh tidur

[Verse 2]
Budak sebelah takut lalu situ malam-malam
Aku temankan dia sampai pagar, setiap malam lepas tu
Dia tak minta, aku pun tak tawar
Kami jalan je, bawah lampu yang tak tahu buat keputusan

[Chorus]
Lampu jalan depan rumah
Aku dah biasa tidur dengan dia berkelip
Kalau satu malam dia terus menyala
Budak tu tak perlukan aku lagi

[Outro - synth, fading]
Semalam orang majlis datang
Lampu tu dah terang. Aku tunggu kat pagar juga.
